subject: Exec sign-off requested: Lumenix onboarding + premium support scope
messages:
From: Erin Blake <erin.blake@lumenix.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenix.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Onboarding + Premium Support Bundle for Lumenix

Hi Dylan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lumenix is ready to move forward but procurement asked for a single-line commercial that includes premium support and a custom integration connector to our EMR. Attached is the SOW (v3) and the pricing breakdown.

Key asks from Lumenix:
- Premium Support (24x7 critical) included for first 12 months
- Dedicated onboarding: 4 engineer-weeks + 2 onsite days for integration
- Custom connector dev and handoff (scope in SOW)
- A one-time onboarding credit and a request for a 20% one-time discount on first-year committed usage to offset integration cost

They want a signed agreement by end of next week to meet a Sep 1 go-live. Procurement said any non-standard discount/added services need executive approval. Can you escalate?

Attachments: SOW_Lumenix_onboard_v3.pdf, Lumenix_pricing_workup.xlsx

Best,
Erin Blake
Head of Partnerships, Lumenix Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Onboarding + Premium Support Bundle for Lumenix

Team — forwarding Lumenix request. TL;DR: 20% one-time discount on year1 + 4w onboarding + 2 onsite days + custom connector. Procurement is explicit that this needs exec approval because it bundles premium SLA with a larger concession.

Quick questions for you both:
- Neha: can you confirm ACV/ARR and upsell potential (is this a strategic anchor account)?
- Vivek: what's the margin hit at 20% + included premium support for 12 months? Any creative accounting (onboarding as professional services billed separately) that keeps us within PS guidelines?

Proposed fallback to present to execs: approve up to 15% one-time discount + include onboarding credits; require paid PS for custom connector but with a committed 9-month usage minimum.

I need language for an executive one-pager and a recommendation by EOD tomorrow.

—Dylan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Onboarding + Premium Support Bundle for Lumenix

Dylan —

Quick commercial read:
- Lumenix committed ACV ask (year 1): $420k (usage + seats).
- Strategic signal: they are piloting the feature for 3 HCO partners; high expansion potential if the integration is stable.
- Churn risk low; legal/compliance is straightforward.

Recommendation: Approve up to 15% one-time discount + include 2 onsite days (as credit) + 3 engineer-weeks of onboarding included. Custom connector should be contracted as billable PS (estimate $45k) but we can offer a 50% discount on PS if they commit to 12 months usage.

I've attached a quick pricing workup (see tab "Concessions") showing P&L impact at 10/15/20% discounts. 15% still keeps gross margin >35% over year 1 when PS is treated as separate revenue.

Neha
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: Onboarding + Premium Support Bundle for Lumenix

Folks —

Finance read:
- At 20% one-time, year1 margin drops to ~18% before factoring PS revenue; that is below our threshold for strategic deals without offsetting terms.
- If we separate PS as billable, margin recovers to ~32% at 15% discount.
- Approving included 12-month premium support materially increases our cost (we would absorb higher support headcount and priority routing); ok for piloting customers but needs an exec trade-off.

Ask for execs: sign-off on a concession package with a not-to-exceed subsidy amount. I can authorize up to $40k one-time credit from Finance as long as Legal signs off on SLA carve-outs and we get 9-month minimum commitment. Anything above that needs VP/GM approval.

I'll attach a short finance memo (copied into pricing workbook).

Vivek
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Exec decision requested — Lumenix commercial concession summary

Marissa / Vivek / Laura —

Executive summary for decision (one paragraph): Lumenix (prospect) requests inclusion of 12-month premium support, a custom EMR connector developed during onboarding, 2 onsite days and a 20% one-time discount on year1 committed usage to accelerate Sep 1 go-live. Proposed commercial package that keeps us within risk tolerance: 15% one-time discount + include 2 onsite days (as credit) + 3 engineer-weeks included; custom connector contracted as billable PS with 50% PS discount contingent on 12-month minimum commitment. Finance can back $40k one-time subsidy; anything above needs your approval.

Options (short):
- Approve (15% + credits + PS discount, $40k subsidy max) — fastest close, lowers friction, keeps runway for expansion.
- Approve 20% but require extended 12-month lock + 50% of PS paid upfront (better margin) — needs VP approval.
- Decline concessions; offer standard SOW with paid PS and 10% discount — likely delays close.

Recommendation: Approve Option 1.

Ask: Please reply with APPROVE / APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS / DECLINE and any quick conditions you want applied (DocuSign amendment, SLA carve-outs, prepaid PS, etc.). I will turn to procurement and legal immediately after your reply.

Thanks — time sensitive for their procurement deadline Aug 6.

—Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec decision requested — Lumenix commercial concession summary

Approve with conditions. APPROVE Option 1 (15% one-time discount + credits + PS discount up to 50% contingent on 12mo lock). Conditions:
- Legal to include SLA carve-out for custom connector during onboarding (no premium SLA for first 30 days post-delivery)
- DocuSign amendment to include payment milestone for PS (50% upfront if PS > $25k)
- Procurement must confirm they accept the 9-month minimum usage or a 50% clawback if they churn before 9 months.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Erin Blake <erin.blake@lumenix.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenix.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Proposal: Onboarding + Premium Support Bundle for Lumenix — Exec outcome

Erin —

Thanks for the patience. Executive decision: we can proceed on the revised package. Summary of approved commercial terms:
- One-time 15% discount on year1 committed usage (applied to invoice at signature)
- Included credits: 2 onsite days + 3 engineer-weeks (applied as credits in SOW)
- Custom connector: billable PS estimated $45k, offered at 50% discount if Lumenix commits to 12 months usage (9-month minimum applies otherwise clawback)
- Premium support (12 months) included, with SLA carve-out: no premium response SLA for the connector in the first 30 days post-delivery
- Finance to provide up to $40k one-time subsidy (applied as a credit)

Next steps: I will have Legal prepare a DocuSign amendment with the SLA carve-out and PS milestone (50% upfront if PS > $25k). Please confirm acceptance by EOD Aug 6 and we will circulate documents.

DocuSign link (in progress): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/sample-envelope-id-9A2X
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Thanks — excited to get Lumenix live.

—Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
